text:
Aapki baat bilkul sahi hai, aur main samajh sakta hoon ki aapko crockery set ki zaroorat thi. 

Kyunki hamare system mein direct replacement ka option abhi available nahi hai, isliye main aapki call ek human agent ko transfer kar raha hoon jo aapke liye naye order ya replacement ki vyavastha kar sakein. Kripya line par bane rahein.
